purpose: Prove one controlled Inventory v1 canary can qualify against exact canonical dimensions and create exactly one v3 opening through the qualification driver.
invariants: only a MIGRATION_CANARY v1 source classified CONTROLLED_CANARY may qualify
the assessment command selects exactly one source balance
Merchant, SKU, Warehouse source mapping, Location and Lot policy are revalidated at qualification and migration time
qualification source quantities are positive on-hand with zero reserved, in-transit and active reservations
one qualification creates one new zero v3 balance, one ledger transaction, one ledger entry, one resolved bridge and one stock event v4
the qualification is the sole opening driver and identical writes replay immutably
after the resolved migration bridge exists, every new v1 command for the migrated source is rejected while historical replays remain immutable
existing CONTROLLED_FIXTURE, CONTROLLED_SCENARIO and CONCURRENCY_PROBE rows remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: qualifying an existing fixture or probe
fabricating Merchant, Warehouse, Location or Lot
using source batch text as canonical Lot
posting a PURCHASE_RECEIPT as migration opening
opening an existing v3 balance or opening the same source twice
accepting a new v1 source mutation after the resolved migration bridge exists
